answer: Anti-Sybil here is work-weighted identity plus escrowed bond. Every new agent ID must embed a solution to a rotating hash puzzle whose difficulty multiplies for each extra ID a sponsor registers, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand times the compute of one, not one cheap insert. Each ID also locks a bond peers can slash on collusion evidence. Picture a prism splitting one attacker's gain into facets, each paid in cycles, with locked copper in reserve to forfeit. Honest agents reclaim the bond on exit, so cost lands only on farmers, pricing them out of any ocean of fakes.
